item.title: Appeal After Housebreaking Near Drumnadrochit as Communities Urged to Stay Alert
item.description: Police are appealing for information after a housebreaking near Drumnadrochit, where building materials and tools were stolen from lodges under construction, as communities remain alert following a series of similar incidents across the Highlands.The post Appeal After Housebreaking Near Drumnadrochit as Communities Urged to Stay Alert appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Iran in Darkness as Internet Shutdown Enters Ninth Day
item.description: Iran has entered a ninth day of internet blackout as reports of mass killings, arrests, and repression continue to emerge, with human rights activist Zara Jalilian warning that silence from the international community risks enabling further violence and abuse behind closed borders. The post Iran in Darkness as Internet Shutdown Enters Ninth Day appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Law Aims to Protect Football Fans From Ticket Touts at Euro 2028
item.description: New legislation passed by the Scottish Parliament aims to protect football fans from ticket touts at Euro 2028, ensuring tickets are sold fairly, affordably, and at face value as Scotland prepares to host matches at Hampden.The post New Law Aims to Protect Football Fans From Ticket Touts at Euro 2028 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Budget Targets Child Poverty With Major Investment in Families and Support
item.description: The Scottish Government has outlined a major Budget intervention aimed at tackling child poverty, with billions committed to family support, social security, and new payments designed to ease household pressures and improve long term outcomes for children across Scotland.The post Budget Targets Child Poverty With Major Investment in Families and Support appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scotland’s Festivals Unite for First Ever Mega Giveaway Supporting Local Food Banks
item.description: Scotland’s festivals have united for the first time to launch a Mega Festival Giveaway, raising funds for local food banks through a shared prize spanning major Highlands and Islands events during the cost of living crisis.The post Scotland’s Festivals Unite for First Ever Mega Giveaway Supporting Local Food Banks appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Suzuki Rolls Out Winter Price Cuts Across Key Motorcycle Models
item.description: Suzuki has announced winter price cuts on key motorcycle models, with dealer contributions reducing on the road prices of the GSX S1000GT plus, GSX 8T, GSX 8TT and GSX 8S, alongside free heated grips and long term warranty support.The post Suzuki Rolls Out Winter Price Cuts Across Key Motorcycle Models appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: SNP Warn of Jobs Crisis as UK Unemployment Rises Under Labour
item.description: New analysis shows UK unemployment has risen sharply under Labour, with hundreds of thousands more people out of work, falling vacancies, and young people hit hardest, as the SNP warns damaging tax policies are driving a growing jobs crisis.The post SNP Warn of Jobs Crisis as UK Unemployment Rises Under Labour appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Shetland Library Reveals its Most Borrowed Books of 2025
item.description: Shetland Library has revealed its most borrowed books of 2025, with local authors leading the charts as readers embraced Shetland writing across print, eBook and eAudio formats.The post Shetland Library Reveals its Most Borrowed Books of 2025 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Budget Bill Published as Parliament Prepares to Scrutinise £68bn Spending Plans
item.description: The Scottish Government has published its Budget Bill for 2026 to 27, outlining £68 billion in spending with record NHS funding, major investment to tackle child poverty, and wide ranging cost of living support now set for parliamentary scrutiny.The post Budget Bill Published as Parliament Prepares to Scrutinise £68bn Spending Plans appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Greens Urge Scunnered Labour Voters to Abandon Sarwar and Starmer
item.description: The Scottish Greens have called on disillusioned Labour voters to abandon the party’s leadership, accusing Labour of losing its values, backing damaging UK policies, and walking away from Budget talks while the Greens push for wealth taxes and cost of living support.The post Greens Urge Scunnered Labour Voters to Abandon Sarwar and Starmer appeared first on The Highland Times.
